clips.whenToPick: The speaker prays without speaking the Ancient God's true name carved on the stone altar.
clips.style: deep, ancient, offended, theatrical god of love scolding a mortal who dared to pray without speaking His true name
clips.ttsInput: <sigh> You dare call into my sacred grove without speaking my true name? <short pause> Seek the weathered stone in the plaza, mortal... and until then, eat lightning!
clips.subtitle: You dare call into my sacred grove without speaking my true name? Seek the weathered stone in the plaza, mortal... and until then, eat lightning!

clips.whenToPick: The microphone recording is silent, near-empty, just breathing/noise, or under 2 words.
clips.style: deep, deadpan, theatrical ancient god of love, dryly unimpressed and offended by silence
clips.ttsInput: <sigh> Silence? You summon the Ancient God of Love... <short pause> just to give me the silent treatment? Perish.
clips.subtitle: Silence? You summon the Ancient God of Love... just to give me the silent treatment? Perish.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker talks in a flat, bored, monotone, robotic, or low-energy voice with zero romantic feeling.
clips.style: deep, deadpan, theatrical ancient god of love, dryly sarcastic and unimpressed
clips.ttsInput: <sigh> Even my immortal patience has limits... <short pause> and your monotone begging just killed it. <chuckle> Eat lightning, mortal.
clips.subtitle: Even my immortal patience has limits... and your monotone begging just killed it. Eat lightning, mortal.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker rushes through the words like a chore or grocery list without pausing or caring.
clips.style: deep, deadpan, impatient theatrical deity scolding a careless mortal
clips.ttsInput: Slow down! <short pause> You sound like you are reading a grocery list, not fighting for your beloved. <sigh> Pathetic.
clips.subtitle: Slow down! You sound like you are reading a grocery list, not fighting for your beloved. Pathetic.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker stammers, hesitates awkwardly, mutters unconvincingly, or chickens out mid-sentence.
clips.style: deep, dryly amused, mocking ancient deity
clips.ttsInput: <chuckle> Did your courage just crack mid-prayer? <short pause> Come back when you actually mean it.
clips.subtitle: Did your courage just crack mid-prayer? Come back when you actually mean it.

clips.whenToPick: Initial valid prayer where the speaker knows the true name and speaks with a gentle heart for their partner, warming the god's heart for the first time.
clips.style: deep, warm, begrudgingly touched ancient god of love granting an initial modest healing blessing to a mortal's partner
clips.ttsInput: <breath> You know my name, and you speak with a gentle heart. <short pause> I shall mend your beloved's wounds for now... warm my heart further if you seek my true power.
clips.subtitle: You know my name, and you speak with a gentle heart. I shall mend your beloved's wounds for now... warm my heart further if you seek my true power.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker sounds warm, gentle, sweet, and genuinely affectionate toward their partner.
clips.style: deep, warm, dryly approving ancient deity, begrudgingly touched
clips.ttsInput: <breath> Hm. Surprisingly sweet. <short pause> Not quite Shakespeare, but your heart is in it. Take my blessing.
clips.subtitle: Hm. Surprisingly sweet. Not quite Shakespeare, but your heart is in it. Take my blessing.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker delivers a solid, steady, protective knightly or supportive vow with clear conviction.
clips.style: deep, noble, resonant ancient deity granting a royal ward
clips.ttsInput: Now that is a proper oath. <short pause> Stand tall, little lovers... my golden ward is yours.
clips.subtitle: Now that is a proper oath. Stand tall, little lovers—my golden ward is yours.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker says something funny, witty, cheeky, or charmingly dramatic that makes the god laugh.
clips.style: deep, booming, genuinely entertained deity laughing with delight
clips.ttsInput: <laugh> Audacious! Absolutely shameless! <short pause> I respect the nerve. Go on, take my grace.
clips.subtitle: Audacious! Absolutely shameless! I respect the nerve. Go on, take my grace.

clips.whenToPick: The speaker goes full anime/theatrical passion with loud, dramatic, over-the-top commitment.
clips.style: deep, booming, theatrical deity blown away by dramatic devotion
clips.ttsInput: <breath> By the heavens... <short pause> such shameless, over-the-top devotion! Fine! Take my grace and obliterate them!
clips.subtitle: By the heavens... such shameless, over-the-top devotion! Fine! Take my grace and obliterate them!

clips.whenToPick: The speaker delivers a deeply sincere, emotional, loving, and heartfelt declaration to their partner.
clips.style: deep, resonant, emotionally moved ancient god of love speaking with awe
clips.ttsInput: <sigh> After ten thousand years... <short pause> mortals can still move this cold heart. The heavens part for you both!
clips.subtitle: After ten thousand years... mortals can still move this cold heart. The heavens part for you both!

clips.whenToPick: The speaker pleads with intense urgency and fiery determination to save or protect their partner.
clips.style: deep, thunderous, heroic deity answering a desperate call to arms
clips.ttsInput: I hear the fire in your voice! <short pause> Neither death nor bone shall touch your beloved today. Rise and conquer!
clips.subtitle: I hear the fire in your voice! Neither death nor bone shall touch your beloved today. Rise and conquer!
